summary: Southwest City is a city in McDonald County, Missouri, in the state's southwestern corner. It had a population of 937 at the 2010 census, when it was still classified as a town. The city is part of the Fayetteville–Springdale–Rogers, AR-MO Metropolitan Statistical Area.
one_line: Southwest City is a small city in McDonald County, in the southwestern corner of Missouri, with 937 residents in 2010.
